data.long_meaning: Xaviera is derived from the Latin word 'Xavierius', meaning 'new house' or 'new estate'. In Christian history, St. Francis Xavier is a popular bearer of this name. He was a Spanish priest who co-founded the Society of Jesus, also known as the Jesuits. St. Francis Xavier's missionary work played a significant role in spreading Christianity throughout India and the Far East.
